title: Reconstructing built-up land in Toruń and Bydgoszcz (Poland) 1975–2025 from Landsat with a Dynamic World-trained Random Forest: code and result data
description:
Code (Google Colab notebook) and result data for reconstructing built-up land expansion in Toruń and Bydgoszcz (Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland), 1975–2025. A Random Forest classifier trained only on the Dynamic World built-up label of 2025 is applied without retraining to Landsat TM, ETM+ and OLI median composites for the epochs 1985–2025 (30 m); two constraints (a present-day extent mask and monotonic accumulation) produce the final series. A second-stage classifier trained on the 1985 map and pseudo-labels extends the series to Landsat MSS data for 1975 and 1980 (60 m). Every map version is compared with a static model (the present-day extent assigned to every year) on shared point panels against WSF Evolution, CORINE Land Cover patch cores, Urban Atlas and a blind photo-interpretation of the 2023 orthophoto, and the frozen procedure is transferred from Toruń to Bydgoszcz. The notebook also computes urban sprawl indicators, landscape metrics and the SDG 11.3.1 indicator (LCRPGR), including on the 1 km census grids of the 2011 and 2021 Polish censuses.

Contents: the notebook (24 chapters, 167 code cells, no stored outputs), the environment file of the executed run (Google Colab, Python 3.13, Google Earth Engine Python API 1.7.39), result tables (CSV), model cards and classifier register, evaluation point panels, own input data (zone boundaries, barriers, census grid indicators) and file lists with data sources and licences. All random draws use seed 42. Code: MIT licence. Result tables, model cards, metadata and own data: CC BY 4.0. Source data (Landsat, Sentinel-2, Dynamic World, WSF Evolution, CORINE Land Cover, Urban Atlas, GUGiK orthophoto and boundaries, GUS, GDOŚ, GHS-POP) remain subject to their providers' licences and are not redistributed. GeoTIFF rasters of the map series are deposited in a separate Zenodo record (see related identifiers). Documentation is in Polish with an English summary.

Kod analizy (notatnik Google Colab) i dane wynikowe do rekonstrukcji rozwoju zabudowy Torunia i Bydgoszczy w latach 1975–2025. Klasyfikator Random Forest uczony wyłącznie na etykiecie zabudowy Dynamic World z 2025 r. jest stosowany bez ponownego uczenia do kompozytów Landsat z epok 1985–2025 (30 m), a przez most sensorowy w epoce 1985 do danych Landsat MSS z lat 1975 i 1980 (60 m). Każda wersja mapy jest porównywana z modelem statycznym na wspólnych panelach punktów względem WSF Evolution, CORINE Land Cover, Urban Atlas i ślepej fotointerpretacji ortofotomapy z 2023 r.; procedura jest przenoszona z Torunia do Bydgoszczy. Notatnik oblicza także wskaźniki urban sprawl, metryki krajobrazowe i wskaźnik SDG 11.3.1 (LCRPGR) na siatce kilometrowej NSP 2011 i NSP 2021. Kod: licencja MIT; dane wynikowe: CC BY 4.0.
